finalText:
All 12 files checked out clean, no syntax errors.

Migration's done. I switched 12 files from `db.query` to `db.execute` — the same call sites you'd expect, one `SELECT` by id, one list query, one `UPDATE`, in each. That leaves one call site still on `db.query`: `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`. That file is a vendored copy of a third-party package, marked "do not edit — replaced wholesale on every upgrade." I left it alone since any change there gets thrown away anyway.
